title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: Terminal-themed portfolio built with Laravel 12, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS v4. Features an interactive Linux terminal on the homepage.

blocks.content: This portfolio site is built from scratch as a terminal-themed interactive experience. The homepage is a fully functional Linux terminal where visitors can run commands to explore the portfolio.

items: Interactive Linux terminal with real commands (ls, cd, cat, fastfetch, matrix, whoami)
Virtual filesystem backed by Markdown files in resources/data/terminal/
Dark theme (default) and Solarized Light theme, persisted in localStorage
Fluid responsive design using clamp() — no breakpoint jumps
GitHub Actions CI/CD with zero-downtime deployment via Deployer
Server hardened with Cloudflare Authenticated Origin Pulls and custom UFW rules

blocks.content: Laravel 12, PHP 8.3, Alpine.js 3.x, Tailwind CSS v4, Vite 6, marked.js. Deployed on Ubuntu 24 behind Cloudflare with Nginx + PHP-FPM.

title: Discord Music Bot
description: Automated Discord bot providing music playback, queue management, and utility commands via discord.py and yt-dlp.

blocks.content: An automated Discord bot providing music playback, queue management, and utility commands for server members.

items: Stream audio from YouTube directly into voice channels
Queue system: add, skip, pause, resume, shuffle
Search by song name or URL

blocks.content: Built using discord.py with async/await throughout. Audio is streamed via yt-dlp + FFmpeg — no local file storage needed. Runs on a home server.

title: Signal E-Commerce Bot
description: Automated e-commerce shop bot on the Signal messaging platform with product browsing, ordering, and payment flows.

blocks.content: An automated e-commerce shop bot built on the Signal messaging platform, enabling product browsing, ordering, and payment flows directly within Signal chats.

items: Product catalogue browsing via chat commands

blocks.content: Signal's end-to-end encryption made it an interesting platform for private commerce. The project was a technical challenge to build a full e-commerce flow within the constraints of a messaging API.

title: Movie Database
description: Full-stack web application for browsing, searching, and reviewing films. Built as an academic project at UEA.

blocks.content: A full-stack web application for browsing, searching, and reviewing films. Built as an academic project at the University of East Anglia.

items: Search by title, genre, or year
Detailed movie pages with cast and synopsis

blocks.content: Built for the Web Technologies module. Graded on database design, code quality, and UI/UX.

title: 2D Platformer — Graphics Module
description: 2D platformer game with a custom OpenGL rendering pipeline, GLSL shaders, and physics — built for the Graphics 1 module at UEA.

blocks.content: A 2D platformer game built using OpenGL for GPU-accelerated rendering as part of the Graphics 1 module at UEA.

items: Physics: gravity, collision detection, jump mechanics
Animated sprites with sprite sheet support

blocks.content: Rendering pipeline built from scratch — no game engine. Sprites rendered as textured quads via a custom VAO/VBO setup. Collision uses AABB detection. Achieved distinction.

title: Landlord Management System
description: Work-in-progress property management platform for landlords and tenants with maintenance requests and rent tracking.

blocks.content: A property management platform designed to streamline landlord-tenant relationships, maintenance requests, and rent tracking. Currently in development.

items: Tenant portal with lease viewing and maintenance requests

blocks.content: Database schema complete. Laravel authentication and property CRUD implemented. Tenant management in progress. Multi-tenancy with Laravel Policies.
